prayerExcerpt.en-US: Few men have had such natural advantages and such gifts of grace as St. Remi, and few have done so great a work. Learn from him to bear the world's praise as well as its scorn with a lowly and chastened heart.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Poucos homens tiveram tais vantagens naturais e tais dons de graça como São Remi, e poucos realizaram obra tão grande. Aprende com ele a suportar tanto o louvor do mundo quanto o seu escárnio com um coração humilde e mortificado.

meta.face: A Gallo-Roman noble of about sixty, UNUSUALLY TALL, with a LONG NECK and a pale, fine complexion and a LONG, NOBLE, symmetrical face — a HIGH, broad, smooth forehead, a LONG, straight, finely cut nose, LARGE, calm grey eyes set LEVEL under LONG, straight silver brows, smooth, LONG cheeks, a small, serene closed mouth, a long, gently rounded chin; silver-grey hair cut short below the mitre; a MEDIUM, neatly combed silver beard, smooth and oval, not full or flowing; the gaze calm and a little lowered, with 'blended majesty and serenity'. Not the lantern-jawed gregory_langres, the square, laughing medard, the square-bearded, domed germanus_auxerre, or the clean-shaven, underbitten germanus_paris.
meta.basis: The book itself describes him: "unusually tall, his face impressed with blended majesty and serenity, his bearing gentle, humble, and retiring". Santi e Beati gives his emblems as the crosier and the flask of oil; the card follows both, and the structure of the face is ours.
